facts.raw_span: a 2-month history of a slowly growing, dull, intermittent swelling and discomfort in the right upper vestibule
fluctuations in pain intensity and a sensation of heaviness in the area
teeth #15 and #16 were grossly carious
a firm, mildly tender diffuse swelling of the adjacent vestibular mucosa
no tenderness on percussion of the involved teeth
a mild periapical radiolucency at the affected root apices
a provisional diagnosis of a periapical abscess was made
preoperative blood tests were within normal limits
curettage yielded a gelatinous, soft, mushy tissue
a provisional diagnosis of periapical granuloma

concepts.why: The patient presented with a slowly growing swelling and discomfort in the right upper vestibule, with a firm, mildly tender diffuse swelling of the adjacent vestibular mucosa, and a mild periapical radiolucency at the affected root apices, which is consistent with a periapical abscess.
The patient had grossly carious teeth, and curettage yielded a gelatinous, soft, mushy tissue, which is consistent with a periapical granuloma.
The patient presented with a slowly growing swelling and discomfort in the right upper vestibule, with fluctuations in pain intensity, which is consistent with chronic apical periodontitis.
The patient had grossly carious teeth, which is consistent with dental caries.
The patient had a mild periapical radiolucency at the affected root apices, and curettage yielded a gelatinous, soft, mushy tissue, which is consistent with a periapical cyst.

The patient presented with a slowly growing swelling and discomfort in the right upper vestibule, with a firm, mildly tender diffuse swelling of the adjacent vestibular mucosa, which is consistent with acute apical periodontitis.
The patient had grossly carious teeth, and no tenderness on percussion of the involved teeth, which is consistent with pulpal necrosis.
The patient had a provisional diagnosis of periapical granuloma, and curettage yielded a gelatinous, soft, mushy tissue, which is consistent with periapical granuloma with cystic degeneration.
